purpose: Revisit only Campaign157 route c157_04 and determine whether a close-known issuer-level equity-option implied downside-skew or term-structure factor can be identified under the user's existing 3000-point authorization, point-in-time history rules and three-session horizon before any formula, direction or value is opened.

prior_deferred_route.name: equity_option_implied_skew_or_term_structure_mapped_to_issuer
prior_deferred_route.economic_hypothesis: A close-known option-implied downside skew or term slope could supply forward-looking risk information distinct from realized minute volatility.

required_contract.issuer_level_underlying: A direct, versioned option-underlying-to-legal-issuer-to-A-share mapping with effective intervals; ETF or index options remain basket states and are not issuer observations.
required_contract.point_in_time_contract_master: Every live and delisted contract with call/put, strike, expiry, exercise style, multiplier, adjustment version, first-public timestamp, correction history and corporate-action lineage as known at each signal close.
required_contract.close_known_option_quotes: A deterministic close-known quote convention with bid, ask, last, settlement, zero-trade and stale-quote semantics, plus volume and open-interest quality fields.
required_contract.implied_volatility_inputs: Underlying spot, risk-free curve, dividends or carry, exercise and settlement convention, calendar and a pricing/inversion model frozen before option rows.
required_contract.surface_construction: Strike or delta buckets, moneyness, expiry buckets, interpolation, minimum support, no-arbitrage and liquidity gates, and skew or term aggregation frozen before values.
required_contract.denominator_and_coverage: A survivorship-safe eligible-A-share denominator including issuers without options, with complete 2019-2023 history sufficient for one frozen prevalue coverage gate.

official_public_documentation_evidence.documented_frequency_or_semantics: option identity, underlying contract code, call/put, exercise style, adjusted strike and multiplier, expiry, listing and delisting dates
official_public_documentation_evidence.admission_effect: It exceeds the 3000-point authorization and the documented query/output contract does not establish a daily point-in-time revision archive for delisted and adjusted contracts.

official_public_documentation_evidence.documented_frequency_or_semantics: contract/date/exchange with previous settlement and close, OHLC, settlement, volume, amount and open interest
missing_surface_fields: underlying spot and dividend or carry inputs
contract adjustment version and first-public or correction timestamps
official_public_documentation_evidence.admission_effect: Affordable daily bars alone cannot uniquely identify a close-known issuer-level implied-volatility surface, and the required contract master is outside current authorization.

official_public_documentation_evidence.documented_frequency_or_semantics: the official option catalog lists contract information and daily market data as its provided option datasets
official_public_documentation_evidence.admission_effect: The reviewed official catalog exposes no separate historical implied-volatility, Greeks, bid/ask surface or point-in-time adjustment-history interface that closes the missing contract.

official_public_documentation_evidence.documented_frequency_or_semantics: the reviewed official notice lists five SSE option products whose underlyings are ETF codes 510050, 510300, 510500, 588000 and 588080
official_public_documentation_evidence.admission_effect: These are ETF basket underlyings, not a full-market panel of issuer-level single-stock options.

official_public_documentation_evidence.documented_frequency_or_semantics: the reviewed official product guide lists four SZSE option products on ETFs 159919, 159915, 159922 and 159901
official_public_documentation_evidence.admission_effect: Mapping ETF option states to constituents would require point-in-time constituents and weights and would create a shared basket state rather than direct issuer-level option information.

official_public_documentation_evidence.documented_frequency_or_semantics: the official rules define CSI 300, CSI 1000 and SSE 50 stock-index options as options on their respective equity indexes
official_public_documentation_evidence.admission_effect: An index option surface is common to all contemporaneous constituents and cannot be relabeled as issuer-specific skew without a separately frozen exposure interaction.

official_public_documentation_evidence.documented_frequency_or_semantics: corporate actions can change contract unit and strike, relist adjusted contracts and change trading codes or names
official_public_documentation_evidence.admission_effect: A live contract list or unversioned master cannot be backfilled; historical surface construction requires the exact adjustment lineage as known each day.

official_public_documentation_evidence.documented_frequency_or_semantics: the current reference-file specification includes underlying type, call/put, exercise style, adjusted strike and multiplier, dates, version and status for all not-yet-delisted contracts
official_public_documentation_evidence.admission_effect: A current technical specification for the daily live roster does not itself prove an accepted immutable public 2019-2023 archive, corrections or cross-market issuer-level coverage.

finite_prevalue_catalog.name: exact_full_market_single_stock_option_implied_skew_or_term_slope
finite_prevalue_catalog.reason: The accepted local inventory and reviewed official product sets do not supply direct issuer-level option surfaces across the eligible A-share denominator with complete 2019-2023 history.

finite_prevalue_catalog.name: tushare_opt_daily_plus_opt_basic_synthetic_implied_surface
finite_prevalue_catalog.reason: opt_daily is affordable but contains only daily bars, settlement, volume and open interest; opt_basic requires 5000 points and still does not prove a daily immutable revision archive. The pair does not close bid/ask, carry, dividend, correction or historical adjustment semantics.

finite_prevalue_catalog.name: etf_option_skew_or_term_slope_mapped_to_point_in_time_constituents
finite_prevalue_catalog.reason: SSE and SZSE products reviewed are ETF options. Their surface is a shared basket state; mapping it to holdings requires point-in-time constituent weights and overlap rules and does not create direct issuer option information.

finite_prevalue_catalog.name: index_option_skew_or_term_slope_assigned_to_index_constituents
finite_prevalue_catalog.reason: CFFEX index-option surfaces are identical within a session for every constituent. Cross-sectional ranking would require a fitted stock exposure or interaction that is not part of c157_04 and cannot be chosen after outcomes.

finite_prevalue_catalog.name: close_or_settlement_only_implied_volatility_inversion
finite_prevalue_catalog.reason: A close or settlement value without bid/ask quality, underlying spot, rate curve, dividends or carry, exercise style, settlement convention and frozen solver does not uniquely identify a comparable implied volatility or surface.

finite_prevalue_catalog.name: current_live_option_master_or_product_roster_backfilled_to_2019_2023
finite_prevalue_catalog.reason: Current surviving products or not-yet-delisted contract files cannot be projected backward across expiries, adjustments, relistings, delistings, corrections and historical underlying membership.

finite_prevalue_catalog.name: strike_delta_maturity_liquidity_subset_lag_interaction_or_model_search
finite_prevalue_catalog.reason: Choosing moneyness or delta buckets, expiries, quote filters, open-interest thresholds, interpolation, lags, subsets, constituent exposure interactions or models before a complete source contract would multiply hypotheses and select on realized sparse coverage.

decision.reason: No finite route simultaneously supplies direct issuer-level option observations across the A-share denominator, an immutable point-in-time contract and adjustment master, close-known quote quality, identified implied-volatility inputs, deterministic surface construction and complete survivorship-safe 2019-2023 coverage under current authorization. This is a source-contract rejection, not evidence against the economic hypothesis or its predictive value.
decision.campaign157_c157_04_may_be_retried_only_: A newly authorized and independently accepted immutable source proves complete 2019-2023 direct single-stock option quotes and contract revisions, underlying mapping, bid/ask and liquidity quality, underlying/carry/dividend inputs, corporate-action lineage and a survivorship-safe all-eligible-equity denominator before any option row is read.
decision.campaign157_cross_asset_catalog_after_ca: c157_01 remains independently frozen as Campaign265; c157_02, c157_03 and c157_04 are source-contract terminal; c157_05 and c157_06 were already terminal combinations. No unreviewed deferred c157 route remains.
decision.next_safe_route: Campaign269 may begin a fresh finite concept-only offline scouting pass from repository metadata and genuinely new mechanisms, excluding c157_05, c157_06, Campaign265 alteration and recombination of terminal factors.
